title.en: Landing Place for Dangerous Goods (S.p.c. Pte. Ltd.)

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Port of Singapore Authority Act
[Rg 6.]
(Chapter 236 and Regulation 40(2))
Landing Place for Dangerous Goods (S.p.c. Pte. Ltd.)
N 4
REVISED EDITION 1990
(25th March 1992)
[18th June 1976]
The Port of Singapore Authority hereby declares the wharves, piers and jetties belonging to Singapore Petroleum Co. Pte. Ltd. and more particularly described in the Schedule hereto as a landing place for dangerous goods.
